Layout structure:
A full viewport split layout:
- LEFT 45% (Deep navy #0A0F1D / #0F172A branded panel):
  * Header area: BICE Logo mark with indigo badge icon, 'BICE LMS DATA ACADEMY', and a clean top back link pill '< Back to website'.
  * Cohort badge pill: Green dot indicator 'Enterprise & Individual Enrollment Open'.
  * Hero typography: Large bold white display headline 'Start learning today.' with crisp typography.
  * Subtext: 'Join 12,000+ students mastering Excel, SQL and Python. Equip yourself with practical, production-grade workflows built for corporate data leaders.'
  * Small stats row / cards: 3 distinct sleek dark cards or horizontal stat row showing:
    - '25+' Specialised courses
    - '4.8 ★' (amber-400 star) Consensus rating
    - '96%' Career advancement rate
  * Testimonial quote card at the bottom matching the login screen:
    - 5 amber stars '5.0 / 5.0'
    - 'The curriculum helped our analytics unit cut weekly financial reporting time in half. Gained promotion to Senior BI Analyst within 4 months.'
    - User avatar: Initials 'MR' Michael Roberts, Senior Analytics Associate, KPMG.

- RIGHT 55% (Light #F8FAFC background with centered card container):
  * Top right link: 'Need help? Support desk'.
  * Centered white card (rounded-2xl, border border-slate-200/80, shadow-sm, p-8 or p-10 max-w-lg w-full):
    - Top icon badge: Soft indigo circle or square with user-plus icon.
    - Title: 'Create your account' (text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900).
    - Subtitle: 'Get started with access to masterclasses and enterprise roadmaps'.
    - Form fields:
      1. 'Full name' input: text input with user icon, placeholder 'Samantha Patel' or 'e.g. Alex Morgan'.
      2. 'Email address' input: mail icon, placeholder 'name@company.com' or 'alex.morgan@enterprise.com'.
      3. 'Phone number (optional)' input: phone icon, country code selector '+1' or flag, placeholder '(555) 000-0000'.
      4. 'Password' input: lock icon, password eye toggle, masked dots or typing.
         - Strength meter directly underneath: 4-segment colored bar with all 4 bars filled in vibrant emerald green (#10B981), label 'Strong password' with checkmark in green.
         - Subtle green success hint under the password field: '✓ Meets all criteria (8+ characters, symbols, numbers, uppercase)'.
      5. 'Confirm password' input: lock icon, eye toggle.
      6. Checkbox: 'I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' with interactive checked state and linked indigo text.
      7. Button: Full-width indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm 'Create Account →'.
      8. Divider: Horizontal lines with centered 'OR' or 'or'.
      9. Outlined button: 'Continue with Google' with Google 'G' multicolored logo SVG.
      10. Helper note box with mail icon: Soft slate-50/blue-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-2: 'We will send a verification link to your email address'.
      11. Footer text: 'Already have an account? Log in' (with 'Log in' as indigo link pointing back to login).
  * Bottom compliance line below the card:
    - Lock icon 'Secured with Firebase Authentication • 256-bit TLS encryption'
    - Copyright and links: '© 2025 BICE Data Academy • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service'.
